Name: Joab, Son of Zeruiah
Summary: Joab, David's commander, slew Abner and Amasa in peacetime, fled to the altar when Solomon took the throne, and was slain there by Benaiah for the blood he had shed.
KeyStory: Joab flees to the altar and is slain by Benaiah.
RelatedPeople: King David; King Solomon; Abner, Son of Ner; Amasa, Son of Jether; Zeruiah, Mother of Joab; Zeruiah
LifeLesson: A career of victories cannot cover peacetime murders: blood returns on its own head.
